title: The Costume Contest With Too Many Votes
central_conflict: the judges counted more costume-contest votes than there were visitors
decisive_choice: a second ballot box had collected practice ballots along with the live votes
resolution: separated the practice ballots using the entry record and counted votes transparently
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the judges counted more costume-contest votes than there were visitors during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they recounted each colored bead but the total remained too high; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a second ballot box had collected practice ballots along with the live votes; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they separated the practice ballots using the entry record and counted votes transparently, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Ice Cream That Melted Only on One Side
central_conflict: one row of festival ice cream melted while the neighboring tubs stayed frozen
decisive_choice: the cooler lid had a warped seal that let warm air enter one corner
resolution: replaced the seal and checked every tub before serving

title: The Orchard With No Visitors
central_conflict: the orchard flowers bloomed but the pollinating insects never arrived
decisive_choice: a protective mesh installed during the winter still blocked insects from entering
resolution: opened the appropriate mesh panels and restored safe access for pollinators
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the orchard flowers bloomed but the pollinating insects never arrived during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they planted brighter flowers nearby but the orchard remained empty; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a protective mesh installed during the winter still blocked insects from entering; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they opened the appropriate mesh panels and restored safe access for pollinators, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
